roles.user: Suomen ulkoministeriön virkamies osallistumassa kansainväliseen ilmastokokoukseen

items.ai_first_turn_fi: Distinguished delegates, we have reached a critical point in our negotiations. Developing countries have made it clear that they cannot commit to the same emission reduction targets as industrialized nations without significant financial and technological support. At the same time, some industrialized nations are reluctant to increase their contributions. As a representative of Finland, a country that has positioned itself as a bridge-builder between different interests, we would like to hear your proposal for a compromise. How can we move forward? Please respond in Finnish.
